title: Magnitude of homogeneous Moran sets in the unit interval
summary: Magnitude, denoted by $\operatorname{Mag}(X)$, is a real-valued invariant of compact metric spaces whose large-scale growth reflects their geometry. Willerton showed that, for a compact homogeneous Riemannian manifold $X$, $\operatorname{Mag}(tX)$ grows like $t^{\dim X}$, with the volume of $X$ appearing in its leading asymptotic terms. We study a homogeneous Moran Cantor set $E$ equipped with the Euclidean metric $d$ and with its coding ultrametric $d_u$, writing $E_u=(E,d_u)$.
